data.one_liner: Collection of UI widgets, context-free navigation, snackbars, and Dio helper utilities.
data.what_it_does: Grock provides a collection of helper tools, UI widgets, animations, extensions for strings, numbers, and lists, alongside no-context navigation and snackbar triggers. It also includes an integrated Dio helper for API requests.
use_when: You want context-free navigation and snackbars/dialogs across your app.
You need a quick collection of UI widgets, glassmorphism, and animation helpers.
You want a lightweight Dio wrapper for REST API calls with response handlers.
avoid_when: You prefer modular, single-responsibility packages over all-in-one utility toolkits.
You already use dedicated state management or routing solutions that handle these tasks.
strengths: Extensive extensions for strings, lists, numbers, and widgets.
weaknesses: All-in-one approach can pull in unwanted utilities or bloat.
Limited documentation outside of README examples.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding navigatorKey and scaffoldMessengerKey to MaterialApp.
